import { MeshBasicNodeMaterial } from 'three/webgpu';
import { uv, vec4, vec2 } from 'three/tsl';
import { gsap } from 'gsap';

export default function createNode(config, ctx) {
  const { Group, Mesh, PlaneGeometry, Color } = ctx.THREE;
  const mainGroup = new Group();
  const actives = [];

  // Colors & Styles from spec
  const colors = {
    ink: '#16161d',
    paper: '#e8ecf2',
    accent: '#ff2a38',
    surface: '#0b0b10',
    ...config.intent?.visualSpec?.colors
  };

  // Dimensions based on atlas region (512x320) -> Aspect Ratio 1.6
  const width = 1.6;
  const height = 1.0;

  // Plane Geometry reflecting the aspect ratio
  const geometry = new PlaneGeometry(width, height);
  const material = new MeshBasicNodeMaterial({ transparent: true, opacity: 0.95 });

  // Initial flat base surface color
  material.colorNode = vec4(
    new Color(colors.surface).r,
    new Color(colors.surface).g,
    new Color(colors.surface).b,
    0.95
  );

  const cardMesh = new Mesh(geometry, material);
  mainGroup.add(cardMesh);

  // Load ceramic grain map texture if provided
  if (config.imageUrl) {
    ctx.textureLoader.loadTexture(config.imageUrl).then((texture) => {
      // Direct integration of texture mapping
      material.colorNode = vec4(1.0);
      material.map = texture;
      material.needsUpdate = true;
    }).catch(() => {});
  }

  // Text Content render: "Features 3"
  const textItems = config.textContent ?? config.intent?.visualSpec?.textContent ?? [];
  const titleText = textItems.find(t => t.role === 'headline')?.text ?? 'Features 3';

  // Instantiate text via font atlas
  const textObj = ctx.fontAtlas.createText(titleText, {
    fontSize: 39,
    color: colors.paper,
    align: 'center'
  });
  textObj.position.set(0, 0, 0.05); // Offset forward to prevent z-fighting
  mainGroup.add(textObj);

  // Accent detail line (Signal Red detail) below headline
  const lineGeom = new PlaneGeometry(0.3, 0.015);
  const lineMat = new MeshBasicNodeMaterial({ color: new Color(colors.accent) });
  const lineMesh = new Mesh(lineGeom, lineMat);
  lineMesh.position.set(0, -0.3, 0.06);
  mainGroup.add(lineMesh);

  // Rise-in kinetic entrance motion
  mainGroup.position.set(0, -0.15, 0);
  mainGroup.scale.set(0.95, 0.95, 0.95);

  const tween = gsap.to(mainGroup, {
    x: 0,
    y: 0,
    z: 0,
    scaleX: 1,
    scaleY: 1,
    scaleZ: 1,
    duration: 0.8,
    ease: 'power3.out'
  });
  actives.push(tween);

  // Setup generic userData structure for cleanup and interactions
  mainGroup.userData = {
    handlers: {},
    cleanup: () => {
      actives.forEach((act) => {
        if (act && typeof act.kill === 'function') act.kill();
      });
      geometry.dispose();
      material.dispose();
      lineGeom.dispose();
      lineMat.dispose();
    }
  };

  return mainGroup;
}
